It was released in western countries as a SwitchStrike Starter Pack for CAD$17.99 in Canada, USD$12.99 in the United States, and AUD$24.99 in Australia. ==Layer - Alter Cognite C3== {{Part|Layer - Alter Cognite C3}} ==Disc - 6== {{Part|Disc - 6}} ==Frame - Meteor== {{Part|Frame - Meteor}} ==Driver - Trans== {{Part|Driver - Trans}} ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ===Hasbro=== Alter Cognite C3 Box.jpg|Alter Cognite C3's box ==Trivia== * Possibly because of its type-change gimmick, Alter Cognite C3 6Meteor Trans was labeled as an Attack Type in the Beyblade Burst App, but putting it in Stamina Mode changes this. * This is Hasbro's first official release of the Trans Performance Tip since [[Driver - Zephyr|Zephyr]] was released with [[Nova Nepstrius N2 Vertical Zephyr|Nova Nepstrius N2]] instead of Trans like its Takara Tomy counterpart. * Its name is likely a corruption of "cognition" or its Latin root word "cognitio" as these words are symbolized with cogs and gears, which relates to the theme of the Beyblade. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{SwitchStrike System Beyblades}}

*Archer Wyvern is one of five Beys that pay tribute to the Original Series and the [[Wikipedia:Four Symbols|Four Holy Beasts]] (including the Yellow Dragon of the Center) of the [[Wikipedia:Chinese constellations|Chinese constellations]]:
**Archer Wyvern pays tribute to [[Bit Chip - Dragoon|Dragoon]] from the Original Series, which was based on the Azure Dragon of the East.
**[[Guardian Garudas SD160PF|Guardian Garudas]] pays tribute to [[Bit Chip - Dranzer|Dranzer]] from Original Series, which was based on the Vermilion Bird of the South.
**[[Berserker Byakko 125S|Berserker Byakko]] pays tribute to [[Bit Chip - Driger|Driger]] from the Original Series, which was based on the White Tiger of the West.
**[[Bandit Genbu F230TB|Bandit Genbu]] pays tribute to [[Bit Chip - Draciel|Draciel]] from the Original Series, which was based on the Black Tortoise of the North.
**[[Thief Zirago WA130HF|Thief Zirago]] pays tribute to [[Bit Chip - Strata Dragoon|Strata Dragoon]] from the Original Series, which was based on the Yellow Dragon of the Center.

}}{{Translation|'''Bakuten Henkei Gaia Dragoon'''|爆転変形ガイアドラグーン|Bakuten Henkei Gaia Doragūn}} is a purple recolor of [[Salamalyon]] in the [[Hidden Spirits (Toyline)|Hidden Spirits]] series. It was released as a [[CoroCoro Comic]] exclusive.

==Bit Chip - Bakuten Henkei Gaia Dragoon ==
The Chip depicts Bakuten Henkei Gaia Dragoon. 

==Attack Ring - Fire Cracker==
A beyblade mainly for the looks with the included plastic figure. It is not very good at connecting with attacks. The attack ring has a superficial resemblance to that of [[Dranzer V2]], but has a much higher amount of recoil.

==Weight Disk - Revolver Attack ==
Unlike Salamalyon and Bakutenryu Donitrus, this beyblade uses a Revolver Attack WD instead of Eight Wide.  

Weight: 15 grams. 

==Blade Base - Salamalyon Base ==
The base is attached to the spin gear using a screw. The base is thin and flat. The base has two spikes at the side which allow it to be attached to the dragon figure

beyblades.text:
{{Beyblade Infobox |Image= |-| Product=[[File:BlackDranzerHasbro.jpg]] |-| Anime=[[File:Black Dranzer Anime 4.jpg]] |JPName=ブラックドランザー |RomajiName=Burakku Doranzā |ProductCode=A-38 |Type=Balance |Price= |System=Spin Gear System |Series=Beyblade |ReleaseJP=October 2001 |ReleaseUS=2003 |ReleaseCA=2003 |BitChip=Black Dranzer |AttackRing=Flame Wing |WeightDisk=Eight Heavy |SpinGear=Right SG |BladeBase=Flame Change |Owner=[[Boris Balkov]] (Given to Kai)
[[Kai Hiwatari]] (Returned to Boris) |Creator=[[Rasputin]] |AppearAnime=[[Beyblade - Episode 42|Drawn to the Darkness]] }}{{Translation|'''Black Dranzer'''|ブラックドランザー|Burakku Doranzā}} is a Balance Type Beyblade released by [[Takara]] as part of the [[Spin Gear System]]. It was released in Japan in October, 2001 as a part of the [[Bey Ultimate Stadium]]. It was later released by Hasbro in 2003 to international audiences as part of the ''[[Beyblade: V-Force]]'' toyline. It is a variant of [[Dranzer F]]. ==Attack Ring (AR): Flame Wing== {{Part|Attack Ring - Flame Wing}} ===Use in Smash Attack Customization=== *'''AR''': Flame Wing *'''WD''': 10 Wide *'''BB''': Grip Base ([[Dragoon Grip Attacker]]) This combination is lightweight, resulting in high speeds. The fast movement can be hard to control, unless a shooting technique such as the Sliding Shoot is employed. Use of this technique improves the chances of performing an early KO. ===Use in Upper Attack Customization=== *'''AR''': Flame Wing *'''WD''': 10 Heavy *'''SG''': Neo Right SG *'''SG Core''': Heavy Metal Core ([[Metal Driger (Beyblade)|Metal Driger]]) *'''BB''': Storm Grip ([[Dragoon S]]) This customization makes the best of the Upper Attack that '''Flame Wing''' has. Its heavier weight and low height allows it to lift the opposing beyblade, instead of being pushed downwards. ==Weight Disk (WD): Eight Heavy== {{Part|Weight Disk - Eight Heavy}} ==Spin Gear (SG): Right SG (Triple Change Version)== *'''Weight''': 5 grams '''SG Triple Change Version''' can only be used with '''Flame Change Base'''. Its casing houses a triple-tipped plastic piece, which when pulled down allows the player to change between flat, sharp, and semi-flat tips. Although this tip adds versatility and acts as a good practice base for newer players, some problems start to emerge. First, while able to use three different tips with three different battle styles, it isn’t able to do any of them very well since the SG is too tall. Second, there is a manufacturing flaw with many of the SGs that make the triple-tipped plastic piece too loose to stay on one tip. So during a battle it can get stuck between two of them, significantly reducing endurance and costing the player the match. This unreliability automatically disqualifies it from being a serious choice for many competitive players, but as mentioned before, newer players might find this useful to practice with. In the Hasbro version, the tip changer is green, while it is red in the Takara release. ==Blade Base (BB): Flame Change Base== *'''Weight''': 9 grams This base can only be used in conjunction with '''SG Triple Change Version'''. It contains no other notable features. ==Other Versions== *[[Dranzer F]] ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ====Takara==== Bey Ultimate Stadium.jpg|Bey Ultimate Stadium packaging Black Dranzer Bey.png|Black Dranzer ====Hasbro==== BlackDranzerHasbro.jpg|Black Dranzer BlackDranzerBox.jpg|Packaging BattleCaseBox.jpg|Battle Case packaging BlackDranzerCSBox.jpg|BBA Championship Series release packaging ===Anime=== Black Dranzer Anime 1.jpg|A young Kai takes Black Dranzer Black Dranzer Anime 2.jpg Black Dranzer Anime 3.jpg Black Dranzer Anime 4.jpg Black Dranzer Anime 5.jpg Black Dranzer Anime 6.jpg|Bit Chip Black Dranzer Anime 7.jpg|Absorbing the power of Bit Beasts Black Dranzer Anime 8.png ==Trivia== *Aside from its color scheme, this Beyblade is identical t

USD$7.99 |System = Synchrome System |Series = Beyblade: Shogun Steel |ReleaseJP = September 15, 2012 |ReleaseEN = |ShogunFaceBolt = Behemoth |WarriorWheel = Behemoth |ElementWheel = Berserker |SpinTrack = SR200 |PerformanceTip = BWD |Owner = [[Kira Hayama]] |Element = Earth |AppearAnime = ''[[ZG024|The Cruel Begirados]]'' |AppearManga = ''Beyblade: Shogun Steel - Chapter 05'' |SpecialMoves =[[Iron Brave]] }}'''Berserker Behemoth SR200BWD''' or {{Translation|'''Berserker Begirados SR200BWD'''|バーサーカーベギラドスSR200BWD|Baasaakaa Begiradosu SR200BWD}} is a Stamina Type Beyblade released as part of the [[Synchrome System]]. It was released in Japan on September 15th, 2012 as a Starter. It is owned by [[Kira Hayama]] in the anime and manga. In the anime, Kira later replaced it with [[Gladiator Bahamoote SP230GF]], giving the Behemoth Warrior Wheel to [[Yoshio Iwayama]]. In the manga, Berserker Behemoth evolves into Gladiator Bahamoote. ==Stone Face: Behemoth== [[File:Begirados Motif.PNG|150px|left]] *'''Weight:''' 1.2 grams The motif of this Stone Face depicts the [[wikipedia:Behemoth|Behemoth]], a mythological creature in the Bible. ==Warrior Wheel: Behemoth== {{Part|Warrior Wheel - Behemoth}} ==Element Wheel: Berserker== {{Part|Element Wheel - Berserker}} ==Spin Track: Stamina Ring 200 (SR200)== {{Part|Spin Track - SR200}} ==Performance Tip: Big Wide Defense (BWD)== {{Part|Performance Tip - Big Wide Defense}}As its name suggests, BWD is simply a considerably bigger version of WD: while the latter has a clear width separation with its base that locks onto the Track, BWD takes up all this space, and extends lower too. ==Overall== ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== BerserkerBegiradosSide.jpg Stuf.jpg Begirados Sketch1.jpg Begirados Sketch2.jpg Begi.jpg Begirados Sketch4.jpg Begirados Sketch5.jpg BerserkerBegiradosBox.png BerserkerBehemothBox.jpg BerserkerBehemothContents.jpg ===Anime=== BerserkerBegiradosBeast1.PNG ==Trivia== * This Beyblade is based on Behemoth, a biblical creature that is described in the Book of Job. Coincidentally, a [[Guardian Leviathan 160SB|different Beyblade based on Leviathan]], another biblical creature would debut in this series. * This is the first Beyblade to be based on Behemoth, the second being [[Beast Behemoth Heavy Hold]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Synchrome System Beyblades}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:DNA]]

}}'''Cetus Quake''' is a [[Stealth Battlers]] Beyblade, part of the [[Extreme Top System]]. It is based on [[Grand Cetus WD145RS]] and was released in 2012 in North America.

==Overview==
Cetus Quake has two triggers on its sides that activate when hit. When triggered, the tip slides, causing Cetus Quake to "quake" due to the imbalance caused by the now off-center tip.

==Overall==
Cetus Quake's self-harming gimmick reduces its own Stamina, immediately causing it to wobble and rapidly lose spin. Its weight is also light compared to other Stealth Battlers, and thus is heavily disadvantaged against other Stealth Battlers.

'''As such, Cetus Quake is not recommended for the Stealth Battlers format.'''

[[Ishstar Impact]] }}'''Death Quetzalcoatl 125RDF''' is a [[Balance]] Type [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] that appears in the ''[[Beyblade: Metal Fury]]'' anime and manga, and is owned by [[Tithi]]. It was released by [[Takara Tomy]] on October 22nd, 2011 in Japan. [[Hasbro]] later released this Beyblade as part of the [[Beyblade Legends]] toyline in 2014. In the toyline, it is the successor to [[Quetzalcoatl 90WF]]. ==Face Bolt: Quetzalcoatl== This Face Bolt depicts the Mesoamerican deity, Quetzalcoatl. Its name comes from the Nahuatl language and it means "feathered-serpent." In Mesoamerican mythology, Quetzalcoatl was the deity of Venus, knowledge, arts, merchants, the wind, and transgressions between the Earth and the sky. The design is in a very accurate Mesoamerican recreation of the art style, as well as having a back drop of Mesoamerican script. The design features Quetzalcoatl's face looking to the left with its mouth wide open, sticking out its snake-like tongue while appearing on a bronze Face Bolt. ==4D Clear Wheel: Quetzalcoatl== [[File:Clearwheel4d quetzal.jpg]] *'''Weight:''' 2.6 grams Quetzalcoatl is a translucent bright gold in color. The design is greatly influenced by Quetzalcoatl, as it showcases two cobras adjacent to one another, and both are shown having a set of wings with black Aztec-like highlights. Also like all 4D Energy Rings, it contains metal fillings for added weight, but like most Energy Rings, the effect is negligible. '''Attack: 5 - Defense: 0 - Stamina: 2''' ==4D Metal Wheel: Death== [[File:4DMetalWheelDeath.jpg]] ===Metal Frame=== The wheel and the core are similar to that of Kreis Cygnus and Fusion Hades because you can switch the core over to change its mode. Death's Metal Frame acts as an "upper" layer of some sort to the Wheel. It has a series of upward and downward curves which gives it a serpentine-like look, or either a crown. The Metal Frame also shows more of a snake-like appearance in Defense Mode with its various scales. ===Core=== Death's Core acts a "lower layer" of some sort to the Wheel. It is straighter than the Metal Frame and features eight wing-like protrusions. These protrusions are slanted with various spikes to represent the wings of Quetzalcoatl. When together, Death appears much larger than any other Fusion Wheel seen before except for pre-HWS Escolpio, which is equal to Death in thickness, being 12mm in height. Therefore, Death is known as the "Rotating Wall". Death is also very thick and rock-like in design due to its "layers"; these layers, give it the appearance of Quetzalcoatl's body. *'''Weight:''' 43.6 grams ===Performance=== Death has two modes, "Attack Mode" and "Defense Mode". In Attack Mode, the Metal Frame has a more offensive appearance with a multitude of gaps that, while don't give it sufficient attack power, still give it a grinding ability. In Defense Mode however, the Metal Frame is flipped so that it rests on top of the Core, closing the gaps and thus giving it Defe

beyblades.title: Destroyer Roller
beyblades.text:
{{Beyblade Infobox |Image=DestroyerRoller.jpg |ProductCode=X-206
X-206A |System=Extreme Top System |SpinDirection=Dual-Spin |Price=USD$9.99 |Weight=38.9 grams |Series=Beyblade: Metal Masters |Series2=Beyblade: Metal Fury |ReleaseUS= }}'''Destroyer Roller''' is a [[Stealth Battler]] Beyblade, part of the [[Extreme Top System]]. It is based on [[Gravity Destroyer AD145WD]]. ==Overview== Like other Stealth Battler Beyblades, Destroyer Roller has a gimmick that is activated when any one of its three triggers are struck. As its name implies, Destroyer Roller features three freely rotating rollers draping down at three points on the Bey, opposite to where the triggers are located. When the gimmick is not active, the indicators under the "Energy Ring" will be filled in. When struck, these rollers deploy and in theory help stabilize the Bey when it is knocked off balance, as the freely rotating rollers run along the stadium floor. In practice however, this gimmick only works early in the battle when spin velocity is high; as Destroyer Roller's spin velocity decreases, the gimmick acts as brakes instead, completely nullifying any Life-After-Death. The gimmick often activates at the end of the battle, when the spin velocity is low, and thus the aforementioned issue manifests itself in most of Destroyer Roller's battles. In addition, when making contact with the opposing Bey, these rollers often end up being protrusions that harm spin velocity. ==Overall== Due to the design of Destroyer Roller's gimmick, the protrusions are often detrimental to spin velocity, contrary to their intended purpose. '''As such, Destroyer Roller is recommended for collection purposes only.''' ==Gallery== DestroyerRollerBox.jpg|Packaging DestroyerRoller2.jpg|Contents DestroyerRollerSparkFXBox.jpg|Spark FX Packaging ==Trivia== *Destroyer Roller's gimmick is similar to the [[Driver - Loop|Loop]] Driver in the ''[[Burst Series]]''. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Extreme Top System Beyblades}} [[Category:Stealth Battlers]]

Dragoon Fantom (anime) |ProductCode=A-25 |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Left-Spin |Price= |System=Spin Gear System |Series=Beyblade: 2000 |ReleaseJP= |ReleaseEN= |BitChip=Dragoon |AttackRing=Dual Dragon |WeightDisk=Eight Wide |SpinGear=Left Rotation Spin Gear |BladeBase=Fantom Grip Base |Owner=[[Tyson Granger]] |Creator=[[Kenny]] |AppearAnime=[[Beyblade - Episode 23|Showdown in Vegas]] |AppearManga=[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade (Manga)|Volume 5, Chapter 1]] |SpecialMoves= [[Phantom Hurricane]] }}'''Dragoon F''' is an Attack-type [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] and was [[Tyson Granger|Tyson's]] third Beyblade. It was preceded by [[Dragoon Storm|Dragoon S]] and was replaced by [[Dragoon Victory|Dragoon V]]. ==Bit Chip (BC): Dragoon (F Version)== The chip depicts Dragoon. ==Attack Ring (AR): Dual Dragon== The {{Translation|'''Dual Dragon'''|デュアルドラゴン|Deyuaru Doragon}} is a two-tiered [[Attack Ring]] featuring four dragon-headed themed attack points. The top layer is the central piece of the Attack Ring and featured four, large dragon-head blades of moderate diameter. The secondary layer is a four-bladed ring which connects to the primary layer, for added shock absorption. ==Weight Disk (WD): Eight Wide== {{Part|Weight Disk - Eight Wide}} *'''Weight''': 13 Grams ==Spin Gear (SG): Left Spin Gear== A SG that allows for left spin while using in combination with a left shooter. The left-spin SG was designed very similarly to the right-spin SG, with the exception of the tabs. The tabs on a left-spin SG were situated opposite of the right-spin SG tabs, allowing a left-spin shooter to attach to them. In addition, the left-spin tabs extended out slightly farther than the right-spin tabs, disallowing the usage of a right-spin Shooter on with a left-spin SG, and vice-versa. ==Blade Base (BB): Fantom Grip Base== This attack-based Base has a tall red rubber Grip Shaft at the end. However, although this Base has more rubber than [[Dragoon S]]' Storm Grip Base, the Grip Shaft's rubber is too stiff to build up sufficient friction on the stadium floor for the fast movement patterns the Dragoon series are well known for. In addition, the Base's height is not low enough, either. when the rubber will wear out it will become super aggresive in stadium and have much worst stamina. ==Other Versions== *Dragoon F - Crystal Version *Dragoon F - Metal Master Version (Hasbro) *Dragoon F - Black Version (Sold with a Game Boy Player) *Dragoon F - Blue Version *Dragoon F - HyperBlades Version (Orange and Yellow) (Hasbro) ==Gallery== DragoonF.00.JPG DragoonF.01.jpg|Dragoon F (Takara box) 71V2XiLypRL. }}'''Draciel S''' is a Defense Type [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] and was [[Max Tate|Max]]'s second Beyblade. It was preceded by [[Draciel Metal Ball Defenser]] and was replaced by [[Draciel F]].

==Bit Chip (BC): Draciel==
The chip depicts Draciel. It has 2 different stickers: Death Draciel and regular Draciel.

==Attack Ring (AR): Cross Spike==
*'''Weight:''' 5 grams

Cross Spike’s overall general shape is in the form of a square. It has four projected turtle heads along with multiple flat spikes along it. This Attack Ring has no real use because of its shape and flat spikes that knock it off balance while spinning.

==Weight Forge Disc (WD): Eight Balance==
*'''Weight:''' 14 Grams

==Spin Gear (SG): Right SG ==
The basic right rotation Spin Gear. 

A SG that allows for right spin while using in combination with a right shooter. In a right-spin SG, two tabs (situated close to the right sides of the Spin Gear) would attach to the right-spin Shooter, allowing the Beyblade to be spun in a clockwise motion. It was first released with Driger S.

== Blade Base (BB): SG Metal Ball== 
*'''Weight '''of BB Only: 8 grams
*'''Weight '''of BB with 1 set of metal balls (Original Weight): 10 grams
*'''Weight''' of BB with 2 sets of metal balls: 12 grams

SG Metal Ball is one of the best BB for Defense type customizations. It has a round metal tip which makes it oriented for defense since it has a tendency to remain in the central area of the stadium in order to avoid attacks. The metal tip causes less friction between itself and the stadium which normally allows it to get knocked around in terms of defense, but in this case, its ability to hold up to 2 sets of metal balls prevents this because of the increase in weight.

This BB can hold up to 2 sets of metal balls just like Metal Ball Base (Draciel Metal Ball Defenser) and Fortress Base (Draciel F), however, unlike the other two, it can hold a Heavy Metal Core (Metal Driger) in addition to the 2 sets of metal balls making it the heaviest BB ever at over 20 grams. The combination of the heavy weight on the   metaltip provides one of the best options of defense type BBs to use.

}}'''Draciel F''' is a Defense Type [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] and was [[Max Tate|Max]]'s third Bey. It was preceded by [[Draciel S]] and was replaced by [[Draciel V]].

==Bit Chip (BC): Draciel (F Version)==
The chip depicts Draciel.

==Attack Ring (AR): Eight Spike==
*'''Weight:''' 4.2 grams
Eight Spike has a circular shape with eight protrusions. This Attack Ring, like most of Draciel's, has absolutely no competitive use due to its poor preformance in all fields.

==Weight Disk (WD): Eight Balance==
*'''Weight:''' 14 Grams
The Balance series of Weight Disks has three different versions that were updated as newer Beyblades were released. Chronologically, the first Balance WD to be released was Six Balance, followed by Eight Balance, and finally Ten Balance. The number before the word “Balance” on each WD represents the number of sides on each WD (ex. Eight Balance would have eight sides, making in into an octagon shape).
* ''Note: The six sided version of the Balance WD is officially referred to as simply "Balance", but the word "Six" is commonly used before the word among Bladers to differentiate between all three types.''
The Balance WD has a weight which is between that of Wide and Heavy WDs. Its mass is distributed well, and in theory would be used for both Defense and Endurance purposes. That being said, there is numerous other options which are better for those types, and even Balance types which also in theory would benefit from this type of WD have much better choices (such as Ten Heavy). Ten Balance is the heaviest out of all of the Balance weight disks, and generally speaking, is chosen over Six and Eight Balance when customizing.

==Spin Gear (SG): Right SG (Oil Ball Ver.)==
A SG that allows for right spin while using in combination with a right shooter. In a right-spin SG, two tabs (situated close to the right sides of the Spin Gear) would attach to the right-spin Shooter, allowing the Beyblade to be spun in a clockwise motion. It was first released with Driger S.

==Blade Base (BB): Fortress Base==
*'''Weight of BB Only:''' 12 grams
*'''Weight of BB with 1 set of metal balls (Original Weight):''' 14 grams
*'''Weight of BB with 2 set of metal balls:''' 16 grams
*'''Weight of BB with 3 set of metal balls:''' 18 grams
SG Oil Ball contains a metal ball with an oil reservoir above it, which makes it an excellent Blade Base for Defense. In fact, due to this round metal tip, it has a tendency to remain in the central area of the stadium in order to avoid attacks. The metal tip causes less friction between itself and the Beystadium which normally allows it to get knocked around in terms of defense, but its ability to hold up to 2 or 3 sets of metal balls prevents this because of the increase in weight.

Fortress Base can hold 2 sets of metal balls in its pocket, and 2 additional metal balls in the small holes in the Blade Base, this does however require a specific Weight Disk. Fortress Base can hold Bearing Spin Gears.

Hasbro releases did not come with the grease container and swab.

==Bit Chip: Draciel==

== Anello d' attacco Attack Ring (AR): Max Shield ==
* '''Peso:''' 5 grammi
L' AR di Draciel Metal Ball Defenser ha 4 pannelli dritti attorno. Per questo, non è proprio l'ideale per la Difesa a causa del grande attrito dato dalla rotazione di questi 4 pannelli. A causa delle sue piccole misure è buono da usare con dei WD d'attacco, ma non quanto il Try-Cutter, l' AR di Polta e quello di Ultimate Saizo.

== Disco Peso o Weight Disk (WD): Heavy ==
La serie Heavy dei Dischi Peso ha tre differenti versioni che sono state aggiornate con le successive release dei Beyblade. Cronologicamente, il primo ad essere stato rilasciato è il Six Heavy, seguito dal Eight Heavy e infine il Ten Heavy. Il numero prima della parola “Heavy” di ogni WD rappresenta il numero di lati che il WD possiede (esempio: il WD Eight Heavy ha 8 lati, ha quindi una forma ottogonale).

Come dice la parola “Heavy”, la serie Heavy dei Weight Disk è la più pesante disponibile (includendo anche le categorie di WD che non sono nella categoria di lati Six/Eight/Ten). Grazie al loro peso elevato e alla loro compattezza, gli Heavy sono spesso utilizzati per le combo di tipo Compact per il semplice motivo di aumentare gli RPM. Quando il peso di un Beyblade è focalizzato sul centro (al contrario dei Wide WD che hanno il peso distribuito lungo il loro perimetro), i suoi RPM aumentano. Questo peso viene sfruttato anche per le combinazioni di Difesa, perchè il peso è la caratteristica primaria di quel tipo. Il Ten Heavy è il più pesante tra tutti i WD Heavy e generalmente parlando, è la scelta migliore rispetto a un Six o un Eight Heavy per costruire una combo.
* '''Six Heavy:''' 16 grammi
* '''Eight Heavy:''' 15 grammi
* '''Ten Heavy:''' 17 grammi

==Spin Gear: Right SG==

== Base del Beyblade o Blade Base (BB): Metal Ball Base ==
* '''Peso della singola base:''' 9 grammi
* '''Peso della base con una coppia di Sfere Metalliche o metal balls (Chè è anche il peso originale):''' 11 grammi
* '''Peso della base con due coppie di Sfere Metalliche o metal balls:''' 13 grammi
Metal Ball Base è la parte più preziosa ed interessante di questo Beyblade. Ha un sistema 4-layer che dà l'impressione che sia obsoleta,ma in realtà è ottima per le combo diDifesa grazie anche al peso aggiuntivo che si può ottenere con 2 set di sferette metalliche. MBD è fornito di un solo set nella BB quando viene venduto,l'altro set si deve ottenere in altro modo.

Quando gira velocemente, le metal balls nella base di MBD ruotano sui ponticelli della base fino ad uscire verso la parte più esterna. Questo dà al Beyblade un'ottimo equilibrio facendo sì che la stabilità del suo baricentro aumenti molto grazie ad una distribuzione del peso più uniforme. Quando il Beyblade perderà rotazione,le sferette di metallo torneranno all'interno della Base del vostro Beyblade. Questo ostacolerà l'equilibrio e la stabilità del Beyblade, ma incrementerà il tempo di rotazione. Il compito che deve compiere questo Beyblade è quello di rimanere immobile al centro del campo per metà battaglia,e poi riuscire a durare più del Beyblade avversario nel momento in cui le sferette di metallo tornano nel centro del vostro Beyblade. Tuttavia, la struttura è alquanto imperfetta, in quanto i ponti che contengono le metal balls non sono perfettamente ripidi, così quasi ogni rotazione fa si che le sferette metalliche tornino fuori.

=== '''Aggiungendo le Metal Balls''' ===
Come detto prima, Draciel Metal Ball Defenser è venduto con un solo set di sferette metallic

==Bit Chip: Dragoon==

== Attack Ring (AR) o Anello d'Attacco: Reverse Dragon ==
* '''Peso:''' 5 grammi
Il Reverse Dragon è tutto sommato abbastanza inutile. Esso è stato fortemente sorpassato e ci sono numerose scelte migliori per l'attacco. Il Reverse Dragon fu il primo Anello d'Attacco ideato per l’attacco con rotazione a sinistra.

== Weight Disk (WD) o Disco Peso: Eight Wide ==
* '''Eight Wide:''' 13 grammi
La serie Wide dei Dischi Peso ha tre differenti versioni che sono state aggiornate con le successive release dei Beyblade. Cronologicamente, il primo ad essere stato rilasciato è il Six Wide, seguito dal Eight Wide e infine il Ten Wide. Il numero prima della parola “Wide” di ogni WD rappresenta il numero di lati che il WD possiede (esempio: il WD Eight Wide ha 8 lati, ha quindi una forma ottogonale).
* ''Nota: La versione a sei lati del WD Wide è semplicemente detta "Wide", ma la parola "Six" è comunemente utilizzata dai Bladers come differenziamento tra le tre versioni.''

* ''Sul Ten Wide ci sono alcune rientranze sulla parte superiore ed inferiore (come mostra l'immagine a destra). Su alcuni Eight Wide della Hasbro tuttavia, c'è una sola rientranza sul WD.''
Come dice la parola "Wide", il design della serie Wide dei Weight Disk è uno dei più larghi disponibile. Oltre ad avere un diametro ampio, il peso di questo WD è visivamente distribuito lungo il perimetro. Messo a confronto con un Ten Heavy, ma anche con un Ten Balance, è facile notare la differenza di peso. Il più delle volte, il WD Wide è utilizzato in combinazioni di Durata (e anche per alcune deboli combinazioni di tipoZombie se non si ha disponibile un Wide Survivor o un Wide Defense). Oltre ad essere usato in combo di Durata, i Wide sono anche ben visti per combinazioni che usano loSmash Attack. Con l'uso di un WD Wide su un Beyblade che utilizza questo tipo di attacco potente, si può notare che il range del movimento e la sua velocità aumenteranno di molto, permettendogli di essere più aggressivo e spingere con più facilità il Beyblade avversario fuori dal Beystadium. Il Ten Wide è il più pesante tra tutti i WD Wide e generalmente parlando, è la scelta migliore rispetto a un Six o un Eight Wide per costruire una combo.

== Spin Gear (SG): Left SG ==
Questo SG permette la rotazione verso destra e deve essere usato con l'appostito lanciatore a sinistra. Il design di un Left SG è quasi lo stesso del Right SG, ad eccezione delle due alette. Le alette del Left SG sono situate lateralmente verso sinistra e opposte l'una all'altra e permettono l'aggancio al lanciatore a sinistra. Un Left SG non può essere usato con un lanciatore destro e viceversa proprio per questa differenza di locazione delle alette. E' stato rilasciato per la prima volta conDragoon S.

== Base Beyblade (BB): Storm Grip ==
* '''Peso:''' 4 grammi
La Storm Grip è una delle basi più famose per i Beyblade che utilizzano l’Upper Attack. Essa è dotata di una punta piatta di gomma. Questo rende le combinazioni con la Storm Grip molto veloci e aggressive. Uno dei motivi per cui questa è una delle migliori basi per l’Upper Attack è la sua altezza. La Storm Grip è la base più bassa mai creata. Infatti per effettuare un Upper Attack efficace il proprio Beyblade deve essere più basso di quello dell’avversario. La Storm Grip è inoltre la base più leggera mai creata.

=== '''Utilizzo in Combinazioni d' Attacco''' ===
* '''AR:''' Upper Dragoon ( Master Dragoon, Kid Dragoon)
* '''WD:''' Ten Heavy

** The [[Armor - 3|3 Armor]] from [[Vanish Fafnir Tapered Kick-3]].

[[Tiger Fang]] }}'''Driger F''' is a {{Type|BB Balance HB}} [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] released under the [[Spin Gear System]]. This Beyblade is also the second Beyblade in the Driger series following the [[Driger S|#35 Driger S]]. This Beyblade was designed with a special [[Spin Gear#Gimmick Spin Gears|Gimmick Spin Gear]] featuring a free-spinning shaft designed to work in conjunction with an automatic clutch [[Blade Base]] for in-battle performance mode changes. This Beyblade was featured in the "''[[Beyblade (First Anime Series)|Beyblade]]''" and "''[[Beyblade: V-Force]]''" animes as well as the "''[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade (manga)|Beyblade]]''" manga as the signature Bey for character [[Ray Kon]] before he upgraded to a more [[Driger V|advanced model]]. ==Bit Chip (BC): Driger (F Version)== The Chip depicts Driger. ==Attack Ring (AR): Cross Fang== * Weight: 5 grams Cross Fang features four symmetrical tigers as the main contact points. However, these contact points do not protrude far enough from the AR and are not sharp enough to provide a powerful attack. ==Weight Disk (WD): Eight Balance== *'''Weight:''' 14 grams The Balance WD has a weight which is between that of [[Wide Weight Disks]] and [[Heavy Weight Disks]]. Its mass is distributed well, and in theory would be used for both [[Defense]] and [[Stamina]] purposes. That being said, there are numerous other options which are better for those types, and even [[Balance]] types, which also in theory would benefit from this type of WD, have much better choices (such as Ten Heavy). Ten Balance is the heaviest out of all of the Balance weight disks, and generally speaking, is chosen over Six and Eight Balance when customizing. ==Spin Gear (SG): Right Spin Gear (Full Auto Clutch Ver.)== *'''Weight:''' 7 Grams This Spin Gear features a metal shaft supported by a metal bearing that ends with a Metal Flat tip. The design closely resembles that of [[Dranzer S]] but has a wider metal tip, such that two are not interchangeable. The free-spinning shaft helps reduce the loss of spin when the Beyblade equipped with this part is hit by an opposing top. Customizations using this part, which were tested by WBO member Galaxy in 2011, had proven that the tip is particularly aggressive and hard to control, making it very useful for Attack-Type combos. ==Blade Base (BB): Full Auto Clutch Base== * Weight: 15 grams This Blade Base can only hold the Right SG (Full Auto Clutch Ver.); this base has an increased weight respect to the others, due to the fact that it contains two springs blocked by two metal clips. Full Auto Clutch Base is very unbalanced, and can not be used for competitive purposes. ==Other Versions== * Driger F (Hasbro - Metal Master Ver.) * Driger F (Hasbro - Hyperblade Ver.) * Clear Yellow Driger F (Takara - ??) * Clear Purple Driger F (Takara - Beyblade Driger F Joint Booster, Beyblade C.C.G.) * Driger F (Takara - Burst) * Driger F (Hasbro - Burst) ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ====Takara Tomy==== =====Original Version===== File:24478.jpg|3/4 View File:6955857263 cb9bea0631 z.jpg|Top View File:CIMG0047.JPG|Top View File:6809747592 67ada5b9a4 k.jpg|3/4 View File:6955859667 8a7365808a z.jpg File:6961195879 db1266cc5d k.jpg File:6955859021 85fc7255e5 k.jpg|Bottom View File:6950583919 fedc3c75e3 z.jpg|Parts File:6809750016 c822ab2e4e k.jpg|Attack Ring File:6955861459 4a375d8835 k.jpg|Spin Ge

Driger S was designed with a [[Blade Base]] equipped with the '''Metal Change Tip''', a metal tip with a wide surface and a semi-exposed tip designed to change the performance modes of the Beyblade top as it moves from one area of the stadium to another.

This Beyblade was featured in the "''[[Beyblade (First Anime Series)|Beyblade]]''" anime as well as the "''[[Beyblade (Manga)|Beyblade]]''" manga as the signature Bey for character [[Ray Kon]] before he upgraded to a more [[Driger F|advanced model]].

==Overall==
This Beyblade is a case of an older model being useful all over. Both Tiger Defenser and Metal Change Base are indispensable parts with many uses. The Phantom Force re-release was a godsend for people who missed this Beyblade the first time around. You can practice every shooting technique with this Beyblade, and many Beyblades can be defeated by Driger S with little or no customization. '''Every blader should own multiples of this blade.'''

Flame Thrower }}'''Dranzer F''' is a Balance Type Beyblade that was [[Kai Hiwatari|Kai]]'s second Beyblade. It was preceded by [[Dranzer S]] and was replaced by [[Dranzer V]]. ==Bit Chip (BC): Dranzer (F Version)== The chip depicts Dranzer. ==Attack Ring (AR): Flame Wing== {{Part|Attack Ring - Flame Wing}} ==Weight Disk (WD): Eight Heavy== *'''Weight''': 15 Grams The Heavy series of Weight Disks has three different versions that were updated as newer Beyblades were released. Chronologically, the first Heavy WD to be released was Six Heavy, followed by Eight Heavy, and finally Ten Heavy. The number before the word “Heavy” on each WD represents the number of sides on each WD (ex. Eight Heavy would have eight sides, making it into an octagon shape). * ''Note: The six-sided version of the Heavy WD is officially referred to as simply "Heavy", but the word "Six" is commonly used before the word among Bladers to differentiate between all three types.'' As the name “Heavy” implies, the Heavy series of WDs is the heaviest available weight disk (including WDs not in the Six/Eight/Ten sided category). Due to the heavyweight and the compactness of that weight, the Heavyweight disks are often used for Compact type combos for the simple reason of increased RPM. When the weight of a Beyblade is focused towards the center (as opposed to a Wide WD where it is focused around the perimeter), its RPM will increase. This weight is also often put to use in Defense oriented customs, with weight being the primary concern in that type. Ten Heavy is the heaviest out of all of the Heavyweight disks, and generally speaking, is chosen over Six and Eight Heavy when customizing. ==Spin Gear (SG): Right SG (Triple Change Version)== *'''Weight''': 5 grams '''SG Triple Change Version''' can only be used with '''Flame Change Base'''. Its casing houses a triple-tipped red plastic piece, which when pulled down allows the player to change between flat, sharp, and semi-flat tips. While this tip adds versatility and acts as a good practice base for newer players; problems emerge. First, while able to use three different tips with three different battle styles; it isn’t able to do any of them very well since the SG is too tall. Second, there is a manufacturing flaw with many of the SG’s that make the triple-tipped plastic piece too loose to stay on one tip. So during a battle, it can get stuck between two of them, significantly reducing endurance and costing the player the match. This unreliability automatically disqualifies it from being a serious choice for many competitive players; but as mentioned before, newer players might find this useful to practice with. Great for testing out the different bases, but useless in battle due to its instability. ==Blade Base (BB): Flame Change Base== *'''Weight''': 9 Grams This base can only be used in conjunction with the '''SG Triple Change Version'''. It can also change from 3 different modes. ==Other Versions== *[[Black Dranzer]] *Dranzer F - [http://wiki.worldbeyblade.org/index.php?title=Metal_Master Metal Master] Version (Metallic Blue) *Dranzer F - [http://wiki.worldbeyblade.org/index.php?title=BBA_Championship BBA Championship] Version (Black Dranzer) Spin Gear is green and not all versions include the (Black Dranzer) bit chip sticker. *Dranzer F - Crystal Version *Dranzer F - Coro-Coro Limited (Red) *Dranzer F - (Black Dranzer) included in A/H-38. ==Bit Chip: Dranzer (F Version)==

== Attack Ring (AR): Flame Wing ==
* '''Peso''': 5 grammi
Il '''Flame Wing''' è un AR multi-attacco che serve sia per l'Upper Attack che per lo Smash Attack. Sfortunatamente il suo design "tuttoface" tende ad avere molti meno vantaggi di quanto possa sembrare. La fonte del suo Smash Attack arriva da due piccole tacche smussate alla fine delle punte. In caso di contatto queste tacche hanno il potenziale di causare danni significativi al suo avversario con rotazione a destra. Queste tacche sporgenti sono anche la fonte principale di debolezza dell'AR: la Durata. Come molti altri AR attaccanti Smash, il '''Flame Wing''' è fragile e le tacche tendono a rompersi se si utilizza spesso.

L'Upper Attack è invece fortnito dalle punte angolate verso l'alto, ma non è nemmeno paragonabile alle abilita dell'(Upper Dragoon e del Triple Tiger). La causa di tutto questo è l'angolatura delle punte (circa 10 gradi a differenza dei 15 gradi dell''''Upper Dragoon''' in rotazione a destra). Questo è un AR da utilizzare nel caso non si dispongano di AR migliori per l'Upper Attack o lo Smash Attack.

=== '''Utilizzo in combinazioni con Smash Attack''' ===
* '''AR''': Flame Wing
* '''WD''': 10 Wide
* '''BB''': Grip Base (Dragoon Grip Attacker)
La combo è leggera e ne risulta un alta velocità: questo movimento veloce può essere difficile da controllare, a meno che non vengano utilizzate delle tecniche di lancio come loSliding Shoot. L'utilizzo di questa tecnica aumenta la probabilità di far finire il Beyblade avversario KO molto prima.

=== '''Utilizzo in combinazioni per l'Upper Attack''' ===
* '''AR''': Flame Wing
* '''WD''': 10 Heavy
* '''SG''': Neo Right
* '''SG Core''': Heavy Metal Core (Metal Driger)
* '''BB''': Storm Grip (Dragoon S)
Questa combo tira fuori il miglior potenziale in Upper Attack che il '''Flame Wing''' può scatenare. Essendo pesante e meno alto ha più possibilità di lanciare in aria il Beyblade nemico invece di essere solamente spinto indietro.

== Weight Disk (WD): 8 Heavy ==
* '''Eight Heavy:''' 15 grammi
La serie Heavy dei Dischi Peso ha tre differenti versioni che sono state aggiornate con le successive release dei Beyblade. Cronologicamente, il primo ad essere stato rilasciato è il Six Heavy, seguito dal Eight Heavy e infine il Ten Heavy. Il numero prima della parola “Heavy” di ogni WD rappresenta il numero di lati che il WD possiede (esempio: il WD Eight Heavy ha 8 lati, ha quindi una forma ottogonale).
* ''Nota: La versione a sei lati del WD Heavy è semplicemente detta "Heavy", ma la parola "Six" è comunemente utilizzata dai Bladers come differenziamento tra le tre versioni.''.
Come dice la parola “Heavy”, la serie Heavy dei Weight Disk è la più pesante disponibile (includendo anche le categorie di WD che non sono nella categoria di lati Six/Eight/Ten). Grazie al loro peso elevato e alla loro compattezza, gli Heavy sono spesso utilizzati per le combo di tipo Compact per il semplice motivo di aumentare gli RPM. Quando il peso di un Beyblade è focalizzato sul centro (al contrario dei Wide WD che hanno il peso distribuito lungo il loro perimetro), i suoi RPM aumentano. Questo peso viene sfruttato anche per le combinazioni di Difesa, perchè il peso è la caratteristica primaria di quel tipo. Il Ten Heavy è il più pesante tra tutti i WD Heavy e generalmente parlando, è la scelta migliore rispetto a un Six o un Eight Heavy per costruire una combo.

==Trivia==
*In Roman mythology, Hades' counterpart was Pluto. This is quite fitting, as Fusion Hades' owner is named [[Pluto]].
*Prior to Fusion Hades' release, the [[Fusion Wheel - Hades|Hell]] Metal Wheel was renamed to "''Hades''" in the English dub. This is likely the reason why "''Hades''" was renamed to "Darkhelm" in the English dub of the anime.
**Furthermore, the word "''Fusion''" was used in the English name for the part category "Metal Wheel"; thus making a "''Fusion''" "''Fusion'' Wheel" too confusing. The "''Fusion''" "4D Metal Wheel" was subsequently renamed to the "Firefuse" "''Fusion'' Wheel".
*Fusion Hades is one of two Beyblades (the other being [[Cosmic Pegasus F:D]]) to have a 4D Metal Wheel that is made up of three components.
*Fusion Hades is the second Beyblade of the 4D System released with 7 total components, with [[Big Bang Pegasis 125SF]] being the first.
*Fusion is the only 4D Metal Wheel with a Rubber Frame.
*Fusion Hades' Spirit was never shown in the anime.
*Unlike most Random Booster Prize Beys, this Bey does not have a printed facebolt.

Vex Lucius!]] (flashback) |AppearManga= |SpecialMoves= }}{{Translation|'''First Uranus Mobius 2D'''|ファーストウラヌス・メビウス・2D|Fāsuto Uranusu Mebiusu 2D}} is a Defense Type Beyblade that's a part of the [[Burst System]] as well as the [[Superking Layer System]]. As an anime-exclusive Beyblade, it was never released. In the anime, it is succeeded by [[Variant Lucifer Mobius 2D]]. ==Superking Chip - Uranus== [[File:SuperkingChipUranus.png|left|200px]] {{Part|Superking Chip - Uranus}} ==Ring - First== [[File:RingFirst.png|left|200px]] {{Part|Ring - First}} ==Chassis - 2D== {{Part|Chassis - 2D}} ==Driver - Mobius== [[File:DriverMobius.png|left|150px]] {{Part|Driver - Mobius}} == Gallery== ===Anime=== BBSK-First Uranus Mobius 2D SV.png|Side view of First Uranus (Note the missing blades on the 2D Chassis). BBSK-First Uranus 1.png BBSK-First Uranus 2.png ===Concept Art=== BBSK First Uranus CA.jpg ==Trivia== *First Uranus' name is a combination of the words "first", a term to describe an object or concept that comes before all others in time or order, and "Uranus", the personification of the heavens and father of all the Titans in Greek mythology (Uranus is also the father of the light Titan Hyperion and grandfather of the sun god Helios). **The First portion also refers to First Uranus being the first Beyblade to be built with the Superking Layer System. *In the anime, First Uranus kept the stock combo for Variant Lucifer, with the exception of the rubber blades on the [[Chassis - 2D|2D Chassis]]. In the manga, the 2D Chassis was replaced with the [[Chassis - 1D|1D Chassis]] and [[Disc - Wheel|Wheel Disc]] to advertise the store promotions in July 2020 and the listed combo for the First Uranus Layer. **First Uranus is the first Beyblade in the ''Burst'' series to be upgraded into a new Beyblade. *First Uranus is the first Superking Beyblade to not feature an avatar in the anime. **It is also the first non-generic Beyblade to not feature an avatar in the ''Burst'' anime. *First Uranus is the only Beyblade to never make a physical appearance in the ''Burst'' anime. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Anime Exclusive Burst Beyblades}}

}}'''IR Spin Control Galaxy Pegasus''' is a [[Hasbro]] exclusive IR Spin Control [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] based on [[Galaxy Pegasus W105R2F]]. It is part of the [[Extreme Top System]].

==Description==
Galaxy Pegasus is an IR Spin Control Beyblade which means, it uses an IR Controller/Launcher to control the movement of Galaxy Pegasus for 15 seconds. The controller has various buttons to use these actions. The buttons are as follows, Channel Selector Switch, Reset Button, Power Boost Button which increases the spin speed, Spirit Button which has Galaxy Pegasus make battle call and metal-clashing sounds in an attack called "[[Starbooster Attack]]" and left and right arrows to change the movement of Galaxy Pegasus. The controller also shows these small lights which tell the IR power supply for each attack. The controller is dark blue with red highlights while Galaxy Pegasus, is dark blue, sky blue, red, white and has double layers due to the fact it is an IR Spin Control Beyblade. This Galaxy has a red Face printed on a clear Face Bolt.

Evolution Customize Set (ToyPro) |ProductCode=B-98 |Classification= |Element= |Price=4968円 |System=Burst System |Series=Beyblade Burst Evolution |ProductLine=God Layer System |ReleaseJP=November 11th, 2017 |Contents= |Other= }}The '''God Customize Set''' is a Set released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the ''[[Beyblade Burst Evolution]]'' series. It was released in Japan on November 11th, 2017 for 4968円. ==Product Details== The ''God Customize Set'' is Beyblade set that contains 4 God Layer Beyblade tops, two of which were new releases at the time. The ''Beyblade Burst God Customize Set'' includes 4 God Layer tops: 2 right-spin tops ([[Deep Chaos 4Flow Bearing|Deep Chaos.4F.Br]] and [[Tornado Wyvern 1Meteor Spiral|Tornado Wyvern.1M.Sp]]), 2 left-spin tops ([[Arc Bahamut 2Bump Atomic|Arc Bahamut.2B.At]] and [[Drain Fafnir 7Star Zephyr|Drain Fafnir.7S.Z]]), and a tool for God Chips. Similar to regular Booster packs, this Set only includes Beyblade Burst tops, requiring players to own [[Launcher]]s beforehand to play. The ''God Customize Set'' offers Bladers with Beyblade tops from each of the 4 [[Type]]s, enabling them the option to mix and match the included Energy Layers, Two-Part Forge Discs, and Performance Tips to try to find the best Beyblade Burst top combination to suit their play style. As mentioned before, this Set also marks the release of two Beyblade tops into the franchise: the right-spin ''Deep Chaos.4F.Br'' and the left-spin ''Arc Bahamut.2B.At''. Both Beys would actually make recurring appearances in the ''[[Beyblade Burst Evolution]]'' TV series as the personal Beys for recurring characters, [[Clio Delon]] and [[Boa Alcazaba]]. In the regards to [[Tornado Wyvern 1Meteor Spiral|Tornado Wyvern.1M.Sp]] and [[Drain Fafnir 7Star Zephyr|Drain Fafnir.7S.Z]], their Energy Layers feature ''Metal God Chips'' and require the included God Chip tool to remove. This ''Set'' makes a great gift for fans of the anime series and children who are new to ''Beyblade Burst''. ==Contents== *[[Arc Bahamut 2Bump Atomic]] *[[Deep Chaos 4Flow Bearing]] *[[Drain Fafnir 7Star Zephyr]] *[[Tornado Wyvern 1Meteor Spiral]] *1 Sticker Sheet *1 Bey Code Card *1 Tool *Instructions ==Gallery== B-98 contents.jpg|B-98 Contents aB.jpg|Arc Bahamut 2Bump Atomic dC.jpg|Deep Chaos 4Flow Bearing dF.jpg|Drain Fafnir 7Star Zephyr tW.jpg|Tornado Wyvern 1Meteor Spiral ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Beyblade Box Sets}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]]

==Trivia ==
* Like its predecessors [[Ace Dragon Sting Charge Zan]], [[Grand Dragon Sting Charge Zan]], [[Rock Dragon Sting Charge Zan]], [[Imperial Dragon Ignition']], [[Master Dragon Ignition']] and [[Tempest Dragon Charge Metal 1A]], Gatling Dragon's name and avatar are based on the word "gatling", a rapid-fire, crank-driven gun with a cylindrical cluster of up to six barrels, and "dragon", a mythical monster with a reptilian appearance.
** This is the second Beyblade to use the term "gatling", after [[Driger G]] (Driger Gatling).
* This Beyblade reuses the following parts from previous Beyblades:
** The [[Disc - Karma|Karma Disc]] from [[Guilty Longinus Karma Metal Destroy-2]].
** The [[Armor - 10|10 Armor]] from [[Roar Bahamut Giga Moment-10]] from [[Random Booster Vol. 26]].
* Its packaging lists its Special Move as "Gatling Rush".

}}'''Gravity Destroyer''' is a [[Hasbro]]-Only, IR Spin Control [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] and a variation of [[Gravity Destroyer AD145WD]]. It uses the [[Beyblade: Extreme Top System|Extreme Top System]] and was released on October 2011 in North America. Its product number is X-102.

==Information==
Gravity Destroyer is an IR Spin Control Beyblade which means, it uses an IR Controller/Launcher to control the movement of Gravity Destroyer for fifteen seconds. The controller has various buttons to use these actions. The buttons are as follows, Channel Selector Switch, Reset Button, Power Boost Button which increases the spin speed, Spirit Button which has Gravity Destroyer make battle call and metal-clashing sounds, and left and right arrows to change the movement of Gravity Destroyer. The controller also shows these small lights which show the "IR Power Supply" for each attack.

In design, Gravity Destroyer retains the same basic appearance as its normal counterpart as it shows it's Energy Ring and Fusion Wheel, along with Face Bolt motif. The colors vary however, as the Energy Ring is an opaque dark blue with pink and silver highlights. The Fusion Wheel is more of a grey rather than black and the Face Bolt is a translucent white with the Destroyer Motif printed in light red. Just like the rest of the XTS Beyblades, the parts are not interchangeable. Even though [[Gravity Destroyer AD145WD]] can spin left and right, the IR model can only spin right.

It is owned by [[Kite Unabara]]. ==Shogun Face Bolt - Leviathan== [[File:Reviser.png|150px|left]] The Face Bolt depicts the profile of the sea-dwelling serpent, the Leviathan. With a bright-green skin, this sea serpent rises from the waves of an ocean whereas its tail swirls into the sea with a webbed tail fin. It soon reaches to the point where it curves up to the right to raise head-high, the Leviathan's head. Slightly raising its beak-like mouth to a grin that is very sinister-esque, other webbed proportions come about just next to it. Complimented with a menacing-like, bright-yellow, pupil-less eye, a small nostril and a vast amount of diamonds that scour its body. The Leviathan is finalized on a lime-green background with a bright-blue outing very fitting to act as the waves of the ocean. ==Warrior Wheel - Leviathan== [[File:Chromewheel revizer1.jpg|150px|left]] Showing off quite the impression of being circular, Leviathan carries many elements of its source material into its appearance. The most noticeable would be the Leviathan's head that is resting atop of the Warrior Wheel with a menacing expression. The tail of the legendary creature follows this as it whip-lashes and circles the entire Wheel. Some subtle wave-pool and oceanic designs are then carried to other distinguishable areas but does not fail to showcase some holes here-and-there. Being the almost-circular Warrior Wheel that it is, two holes at two of its sides stop it from achieving the perfection. These holes are formed by the sea-riding waves details that can be visualized additionally as yet another Leviathan raising its jaws. ==Element Wheel - Guardian== [[File:Crystalwheel guardian1.jpg|150px|left]] Almost symmetrical is the case with the Element Wheel that is Guardian. While it does maintain a double-sided curve, quite similar to the Evil Fusion Wheel, it offers encrypted details as well. These such details highly resemble shields that would be in tune with its name and can also be thought of as representing a unique coat of arms. Some simpler depictions of waves sit beside the shield details as a reminder of the Water-influences and overall Element of Water that it presents. Along with a Water insignia that is visible once flipped over, a bright cyan was given to this Crystal Wheel. ==Spin Track - 160== [[File:Track 160 img1.jpg|150px|left]] {{Part|Spin Track - 160}} ==Performance Tip - Spike Ball== [[File:Bottom sb img1.jpg|150px|left]] {{Part|Performance Tip - Spike Ball}} ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ====Takara Tomy==== GuardianLeviathanSide.jpg GuardianRevizer1.jpg GuardianRevizer2.jpg GuardianRevizer3.jpg GuardianRevizer4.jpg GuardianRevizer5.jpg GuardianRevizer6.jpg GuardianRevizer7.jpg GuardianRevizer8.jpg GuardianRevizer9.jpg GuardianRevizer10.jpg GuardianRevizer11.jpg GuardianRevizer12.jpg Guardian

{{Translation|'''Guardian Garudas SD160PF'''|ガーディアンガルダスSD160PF|Gādian Garudasu SD160PF}} is a Defense-Type Beybattle Top that uses the [[Synchrome System]]. It was revealed on June 4, 2013 in the South Korean airing for ''[[Beyblade: Shogun Steel - Episode 22|Doji's Stronghold]]''. It is owned by [[Karura]].

It was originally planned for release in [[Zero-G Random Booster Vol. 4 Guardian Garudas SD160PF]] as BBG-28 but it was canceled for unknown reasons. Possibly because of the slump in Beyblade sales or due to the lost episodes.  

==Shogun Face Bolt: Garudas==
[[File:GarudasStoneFace.png|150px|left]]
Garudas is designed featuring [[wikipedia:Garuda|Garuda]], of Hindu and Buddhist myths. The motif has the bird-like creature looking to its left with its wings folded up. Its head is yellow, with an opened beak, a spike on its head and a long, curved back. Its neck does not connect to the rest of its body. The remaining body consists of Garuda's 20 set of wings (10 for each side). Each wing is long with curved ends; on each side 5 wings are yellow and the other 5 are red. Lastly, its tail in separated into three sections: two yellow spikes surrounding a longer and thinner spikes over red wings. This makes an illusion that Garuda is flying as a whole, or that everything except the head design is a flying Garuda. The design is outlined by a thick green.

==Warrior Wheel: Garudas==
[[File:GarudasChromeWheel.png|150px|left]]
Garudas is a silver Warrior Wheel with a very intricate design. It has an edgy, jagged shape that is mainly circular since it is built for Defense and it uses many stickers that compliment and extend its motif. It has two eye stickers of different colors: its left eye is yellow and its right eye is red. They are put on two face inclinations that resemble heads of [[wikipedia:Garuda|Garuda]]. The two Garuda heads use brown stickers as feathers and have designs for beaks. The left Garuda head is under the right Garuda head. They also use and green and red stickers to represent their respective wingspans. The right Garuda's wingspan even reaches down with its left arm holding onto the Element Wheel hole. Another noticeable feature are the prong stickers. The prongs use yellow stickers with seven, brown fangs on each. It creates an illusion that it is "consuming" its own Shogun Face Bolt, a feature previously utilized with [[Berserker Behemoth SR200BWD]]. Aside from this, due to the amount of asymmetry, parts of its Element Wheel get exposed.

==Element Wheel: Guardian==
[[File:Crystalwheel guardian1.jpg|150px|left]]
{{Part|Element Wheel - Guardian}}

==Spin Track: SD160==
SD160 is a Spin Track that resembles a taller three-sided AD145. As a Defense-Type part, it has three, trapezoid-shaped "walls" (using three-layered designs) that are supposed to protect the top from opposing hits. 

==Performance Tip: Point Flat (PF)==
'''P'''oint '''F'''lat is a Flat version Performance Tip. It uses a pointed spike that protrudes slightly from its flat shape, a similar concept to the FS and FB Tips. As another Bey attacks it, the outer edge, which is a similar circumference to WF, will cause it to counterattack and return to its original place. The aforementioned point in the middle of the tip is to retain Stamina.

X-201B |Weight=44.6 grams |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |System=Extreme Top System |Price=USD$9.99 |Series=Beyblade: Metal Masters |Series2=Beyblade: Metal Fury |ReleaseUS=January 2012 }}'''Kerbecs Blade Blast''' is a [[Stealth Battlers]] Beyblade, part of the ''[[Extreme Top System]]''. It is based on [[Hades Kerbecs BD145DS]] and was released in early January 2012 in North America. ==Overview== Kerbecs Blade Blast resembles its [[Performance Top System]] counterpart of Hades Kerbecs BD145DS, but features a yellow opaque variant of Kerbecs, while its Face Bolt is an opaque yellow with a printed black Kerbecs motif. Its Fusion Wheel resembles Hades but in a yellow color, with red square-like holes between each blade. Underneath these red holes, are pockets for its "red hidden blades" that "unleash to strike opponents". These wings resemble blades, hence the name. In a bottom view, the underside of the Wheel is silver with three triangular, yellow spikes around it. There is a hexagonal-shape as well, and its Performance Tip also appears to be a yellow DS. ==Overall== Kerbecs Blade Blast performs similar to Hades Kerbecs BD145DS, but falls short because of its plastic wheel and spin-reducing blades. The blades actually work against it, since they are not hard or firm enough to stay in place. They lower Kerbecs' stamina when it hits an opposing Bey, although it may also affect the opposing Bey's spin when contact is made. In addition, the blades unbalance Kerbecs, further reducing its stamina. ==Gallery== BeybladeKerbecsBladeBlast.jpg BeybladeKerbecsBladeBlast2.jpg beyblade_kerbecs4.jpg ==References== {{reflist}} {{Extreme Top System Beyblades}} [[Category:Hasbro]] [[Category:Stealth Battlers]]

It was released as a Booster in Japan on January 23rd, 2021 for 1397円. It is the successor to [[Tornado Wyvern 4Glaive Atomic]]. ==Superking Chip - Wyvern== {{Part|Superking Chip - Wyvern}} ==Ring - Jet== {{Part|Ring - Jet (Takara Tomy)}} ==Chassis - 1D== {{Part|Chassis - 1D}} ==Disc - Around== {{Part|Disc - Around}} ==Driver - Just== {{Part|Driver - Just}} ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ====Takara Tomy==== B-177 Box.jpg|Jet Wyvern's box BBSK-Jet Wyvern Around Just 1D 1.png|Angled view on Jet Wyvern B-177 Info.jpg|B-177 info on Jet Wyvern ===Anime=== BBSK-Jet Wyvern rotation.png BBSK-Jet Wyvern Jet Ring free rotation.png BBSK-Jet Wyvern Jet Ring free rotation 2.png BBSK-Jet Wyvern Around Disc.png BBSK-Jet Wyvern Jet Ring spin siphoning.png BBSK-Jet Wyvern Just Driver.png ===Control Art=== BBSK-Jet Wyvern Around Just 1D Beyblade.png ===Concept Art=== BBSK-Jet Wyvern CA.jpg|Jet Wyvern Concept Art. ===Manga=== ==Videos== ベイブレードバースト「ジェットワイバーン.Ar.Js 1D編-マスターブレーダーセレクション-」 ==Trivia== * Like its predecessors [[Wild Wyvern Vertical Orbit]], [[Tornado Wyvern 4Glaive Atomic]] and [[Tornado Wyvern 4 Atomic]], Jet Wyvern's name is a combination of "jet", a rapid stream of either liquid or gas forced out of a narrow opening, and Wyvern, a legendary creature with a dragon's head and wings, a reptilian body, two legs, and a tail often ending in a diamond- or arrow-shaped tip. * This Beyblade reuses the following parts from previous Beyblades: ** The [[Disc - Around|Around Disc]] from [[Flare Dragon Around Planet Sen]]. *** Although the Around Disc debuted with Flare Dragon, this is the first Beyblade to use the Around Disc in the ''Beyblade Burst'' anime. ** The [[Chassis - 1D|1D Chassis]] from [[Curse Satan Hurricane Universe 1D]]. * Jet Wyvern is the second Superking Beyblade to not feature an avatar in the anime, first being [[First Uranus Mobius 2D]]. * This is the first Wyvern to not release towards the beginning of its season. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Superking Layer System Beyblades}}

It was released in western countries as a part of the [[Katana Muramasa M7 and Vanish Cobra C7 Dual Pack]] for USD$16.99 in the United States. ==Drive Chip - Muramasa M7== {{Part|Drive Chip - Muramasa M7}} ==Blade - Katana== {{Part|Blade - Katana}} ==Gravity Ring - 10'== {{Part|Gravity Ring - 10'}} ==Disc - Quacchu-Q== {{Part|Disc - Quacchu-Q}} ==Driver - Mobius-Q== {{Part|Driver - Mobius-Q}} ==Armor Tip - Rise== {{Part|Armor Tip - Rise}} ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ====Hasbro==== Katana Muramasa M7 and Vanish Cobra C7 Box.jpeg|Katana Muramasa M7's box Katana Muramasa M7 and Vanish Cobra C7 Box Backside.jpeg|Backside of Katana Muramasa M7's box Katana Muramasa M7 Render.png|Katana Muramasa M7's box render Katana Muramasa M7 Parts.png|Katana Muramasa M7's parts Katana Muramasa M7 Modes.jpg|Katana Muramasa M7's modes QuadDrive - Katana Muramasa M7 and Vanish Cobra C7 Info.png|Info on Katana Muramasa M7 ===Concept Art=== BBQD-Katana Muramasa RS.jpg|Katana Muramasa initial rough sketch. ''Muramasa'' katana swords were forged by swordsmiths belonging to the ''Muramasa'' school, which was founded by {{Translation|Sengo Muramasa|千子村正}}. * During this Beyblade's development, it was referred to as {{Translation|''[[wikipedia:Murasame|Murasame]]''|村雨}} rather than ''Muramasa''. The Katana Blade was also colored red rather than gold. * Although the finalized development design depicts the Drive Chip with red eyes, the final product released by Hasbro has blue eyes instead. ** Katana Muramasa M7 is the third Beyblade to be [[wikipedia:Samurai|samurai]]-themed, the first being the [[Hard Metal System]] Beyblade [[Samurai Changer MS]] from the [[Original Series]], and the second being the [[Synchrome System]] Beyblade [[Samurai Ifrit W145CF]] from the [[Metal Series]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{QuadDrive System Beyblades}} [[Category:Hasbro Exclusives]]

|Name=Magical Stander}}'''Magical Stander''' is a Beyblade released as part of the [[Spin Gear System]]. It was released in Japan on December 2000 in the [[Bearing Gyros|Bearing Gyro]] Beyblade series.

==Gyro Holder - Balance==
"Balance", the Gyro Holder, is a large plastic casing holding the rest of the Beyblade, as well as having a Tip and various frames to hold the top together. It is not legal for competitive play.

==Attack Ring - Gyro Defense==
''Weight:'' 3.9g

Historically reputed for its survival ability due to a fantastic weight distribution and the shape of its outer edges, and indeed produces exceptional solo spin times. However, the gaps between the two halves of the AR and the flat ends of each half result in very high recoil on impact, meaning it finds more use in offensive combinations than survival types.

The recoil of the gaps largely limit it to wider Weight Disks, as the recoil they cause when exposed counteracts any use for Compacts or Semi-Flat Base Stamina.

The sloped top also results in the Beyblade being pushed downwards by opponents (Force Smashed) and this further exposes the recoil-prone gaps in the AR, which is especially problematic against Circle Survivor Defense on most Zombie tips. These slopes do allow for destabilization of opponents when used in offensive combinations:

as such, despite being one of the best ARs for Solo-Spin times, it is a poor choice for Zombies using standard Survival-oriented tips - but due to great chemistry with [[Spin Gear - Right SG (Full Auto Clutch Version)|SG (Full Auto Clutch Version)]] Shaft, it is nonetheless one of the best Zombie ARs under the right conditions.

==Weight Disk: Gyro Super==
''Weight:'' 27.2g

Heavy, completely round, wider than even Wide Survivor, and with all its weight distributed around its perimeter.

==Spin Gear: Gyro Spin Gear==
''Weight:'' 32.0g

Includes 1x Metal Bearing and 1x Shielded Ball Bearing (listed as "Free Bearing"). Comes without the tip attached, allowing bearings to be swapped as desired, Standard spin gear casings, weight gear and core part. mounted on a long shaft which extends above and below it, which is mounted inside the Gyro Holder (using two bearings) and is used to spin the AR and WD inside the Bearing Gyros when a ripcord is inserted and pulled, just like Magical Ape MS's Gyro Mode. The shaft cannot be fitted to a regular launcher, however aside from the shaft it is a regular Spin Gear.

Ridiculously heavy (in fact, heavier than the total weight of some early Beyblades), completely round, wider than even Wide Survivor, and with all its weight distributed around its perimeter.

==Spin Gear: Gyro Spin Gear==
''Weight:'' 32.0g

Includes 1x Metal Bearing and 1x Shielded Ball Bearing (listed as "Free Bearing"). Comes without the tip attached, allowing bearings to be swapped as desired, Standard spin gear casings, weight gear and core part. mounted on a long shaft which extends above and below it, which is mounted inside the Gyro Holder (using two bearings) and is used to spin the AR and WD inside the Bearing Gyros when a ripcord is inserted and pulled, just like Magical Ape MS's Gyro Mode. The shaft cannot be fitted to a regular launcher, however aside from the shaft it is a regular Spin Gear.

'''Meteo L-Drago''' is a [[Hasbro]]-Only, IR Spin Control Beyblade and a variation of [[Meteo L-Drago LW105LF]]. It uses the [[Beyblade: Extreme Top System|Extreme Top System]] and was released Fall 2011 in the United States.

==Description==
Meteo L-Drago is an IR Spin Control Beyblade which means, it uses an IR Controller/Launcher to control the movement of Meteo L-Drago for 15 seconds. The controller has various buttons to use these actions. The buttons are as follows, Channel Selector Switch, Reset Button, Power Boost Button which increases the spin speed, Spirit Button which has Meteo L-Drago make battle call and metal-clashing sounds, and left and right arrows to change the movement of Meteo L-Drago. The controller also shows these small lights which tell the IR power supply for each attack.

[[Tyson Granger]] (temporarily) }}'''Master Dragoon''' is an Attack Type Beyblade that was released by [[Takara]] as part of the [[Spin Gear System]] in July 2001. ==Attack Ring (AR): Upper Dragoon== Weight: 7 grams Upper Dragoon is the best AR for right and second best for left spin Upper Attack (for other Left Spin Upper Attack AR's, please see [[Dranzer GT|Dranzer GT's]]'s Triangle Wing). Just from looking at it, you can see why this is. This AR has slopes that slant upwards to lift the opposing Beyblade off of the stadium floor. When this occurs, the opposing Beyblade has almost no Defense ability. They can take critical damage from this, and can be knocked out of the stadium. The slopes are also very long, making it more likely to have a successful Upper Attack. ===Use in Attack Customization=== For [[Upper Attack]] to be successful, the slope of Upper Dragoon must be able to reach below the opposing Beyblade. Because of this, using a low BB will make the attack effective against more Beyblades. One of the fastest and lowest BB's available is [[Dragoon S]]'s Storm Grip Base. Combining these two parts, you can make an [[Upper_Attack|Upper Attacker]] that will repeatedly hit the opponent, reducing its [[Survival]] ability and possibly knocking it out. Here is an example combo: *'''AR:''' Upper Dragoon (Master Dragoon, Kid Dragoon) *'''WD: '''Ten Heavy *'''SG: '''Neo-Right/Left SG *'''SG Core:''' Heavy Metal Core (Takara Metal Driger) *'''BB:''' Storm Grip Base (Dragoon S) ===Use in Specialized Upper Attack Customization=== A popular strategy with [[Upper Attack]] is to create a Beyblade that sits in the center of the stadium and allows the other Beyblade to come to it. When it makes contact, it will be lifted, dealt damage and tossed away until it moves back to the center again. This strategy leaves the opponent with nowhere to go, as the opposing Beyblade cannot make contact with you without damaging itself seriously. This Beyblade combines [[Attack]], [[Defense]] and [[Survival]] very effectively. It is hard to knock out of the stadium due to its weight and round shape, has good survival and attacks effectively with Upper Dragoon. *'''AR:''' Upper Dragoon (Master Dragoon, [[Kid Dragoon]]) *'''WD:''' [[Wide Defense]] *'''SG:''' [[Spin Gear - Right SG (Bearing Version)|Right SG]] (Bearing Version) ([[Wolborg]]) *'''SP:''' Defense Ring ([[Voltaic Ape]]) *'''BB:''' Customize Grip Base ([[Dragoon V2]]) ===Use in Defense Customization=== Upper Dragoon is almost perfectly round and is one of the heavier ARs. It can be used to effectively add some [[Attack] ability to your [[Defense]]-type Beyblade. *'''AR:''' Upper Dragoon (Master Dragoon, [[Kid Dragoon]]) *'''WD:''' [[Wide Defense]] *'''SG:''' [[Spin Gear - NEO Right SG|Neo-Right SG]] ([[Flash Leopard]]) *'''SG Core:''' Heavy Metal Core ([[Takara]] [[Metal Driger]]) *'''BB:''' SG Metal Ball Base ([[Draciel S]]) ==Weight Disk (WD): 8-Heavy== ==Spin Gear (SG): Right SG== ==Blade Base (BB): SG Flat== ==Other Versions== * [[Kid Dragoon]] ==Anime== This Beyblade is often seen in the anime along with the other master Beyblades used by amateur bladers without bit beasts. ==Gallery== ====Master Dragoon - Normal Version==== MDragoon1.jpg|Top view MDragoon2.jpg|3/4 view MDragoon3.jpg|Side view MDragoon4.jpg|Bottom view ====Master Dragoon - Copper Version==== MasterDragoonCopper.JPG|Master Dragoon Copper Version ===Anime=== ==Trivia== *Although Master Dragoon was never used by Kenny in the anime or m

}}The {{translation|'''Metal Chip Core'''|メタルチップコア|Metaru Chippu Koa}} is an accessory able to attach to the [[Superking Chips]] of the [[Superking Layer System]].

==Description==
As the name implies, the '''Metal Chip Core''' is a Chip Core featuring metal in the center. A '''Metal Chip Core''' can replace the existing plastic Chip Cores of all Superking Chips, except [[Superking Chip - Diabolos|Diabolos]], [[Superking Chip - Diabolos|Diabolos]], [[Superking Chip - Lucifer 1|Lucifer 1]], [[Superking Chip - Lucifer 2|Lucifer 2]], and [[Superking Chip - Spriggan|Spriggan]], all of which feature their own non-removable metal Chip Cores.

When attached to a Superking Chip, it adds about half a gram of weight. The slight addition of weight increases the Layer's inertia, and thus for Attack Type combinations, it helps them hold a Banking Pattern longer than usual. The added weight also reduces the risk of Bursts and increases Stamina.

The '''Metal Chip Core''' were originally released exclusively as [[wbba.]] event freebies. It was later a standard inclusion with the [[Superking Chip - Helios 2|Helios 2]] and [[Superking Chip - Hyperion 2|Hyperion 2]] Superking Chips.

==Overall==
<tabber>
|-|Burst=
The '''Metal Chip Core''' finds use in Attack Type combinations that use Superking Layers such as [[Ring - Rage|Rage]]. However, Attack Type Superking Layers are outclassed by Dynamite Battle Layers, although they are still somewhat competitive.

'''As such, Metal Chip Cores are not a must-have but a welcome addition for the WBO's Burst format.'''
|-|Burst GT=
'''Metal Chip Cores''' are not legal in the WBO's Burst GT format.
|-|Burst Limited=
'''Metal Chip Cores''' are not legal in the WBO's Burst Limited format.
|-|Burst Classic=
'''Metal Chip Cores''' are not legal in the WBO's Burst Classic format.
<nowiki/>
</tabber>

It is based on [[Galaxy Pegasus W105R2F]] and was released in January 2012 in North America. ==Overview== As with other Stealth Battlers, Pegasus Jumper's gimmick is activated when one of its three triggers are hit. This gimmick, as the name implies, is to jump as its lower half springs down, increasing its height and revealing hidden "wings". Additional hits on Pegasus Jumper can also reactivate this gimmick. ==Overall== Pegasus Jumper's gimmick is one of the least self-detrimental in the Stealth Battlers lineup, and can contribute decent utility in battle. However its weight is somewhat light compared to other Stealth Battlers, and thus can be disadvantaged against other Stealth Battlers if their abilities are not activated. '''As such, Pegasus Jumper is a must have for competitive bladers of a Stealth Battlers Format.''' ==Gallery== PegasusJumperXTS1.jpg|Packaging PegasusJumperXTS2.jpg|Contents PegasusJumperMFBox.jpg|Packaging PegasusJumperTeaser.png ==Trivia== *Pegasus Jumper's color scheme resembles that of the [[Triple Battle Set]] recolor of [[Galaxy Pegasus W105R2F]]. *Pegasus Jumper's ability resembles to the [[Disc-Integrated Driver - Shot|Shot Driver]] of [[Savior Valkyrie Shot-7]] ==References== {{reflist}} {{Extreme Top System Beyblades}} [[Category:Stealth Battlers]]

'''Phantom Fenrir T125JB''' or {{Translation|'''Necromancer Wanrir T125JB'''|ネクロマンサーヴァンリルT125JB|Nekuromansā Vuanriru T125JB}} is a Darkness Element [[Balance]] Type [[Beyblade (toy)|Beyblade]] that appears in the anime ''[[Beyblade: Shogun Steel]]''. It was revealed on June 11, 2013 in the South Korean premiere of the episode ''[[Beyblade: Shogun Steel - Episode 25|The All-Out Mid-Air Battle!]]''. It is owned by [[Doji]] and is the successor to his [[Dark Wolf DF145FS]].

Intended by [[Takara Tomy]] for a release in 2013, this Beyblade was canceled alongside other Beyblades appearing in the [[List of Beyblade: Shogun Steel episodes#Lost Episodes|"lost" episodes of the ''Shogun Steel'' anime]]. It also appears in the ''[[Beyblade: Evolution]]'' video game with the SR200PF combo.

==Shogun Face Bolt - Fenrir==
[[File:FenrirStoneFace.png|150px|left]]
Fenrir features the head of [[wikipedia:Fenrir|the mythical beast of the same name]]. Fenrir's head is very reminiscent to the Face Bolt design [[Dark Wolf DF145FS]] because it poses the wolf facing front and opening its mouth. Its mouth is much wider and has more of an oval shape. Its sides make it appear husky as well. The whole design is grey and is outlined in black.

==Warrior Wheel - Fenrir==
[[File:WanrirChromeWheel.png|150px|left]]
Fenrir is a silver Balance-Type Warrior Wheel. While mostly circular, it shape is very jagged and edgy. It is similar to [[Archer Gargoyle SA165WSF]] and [[Gladiator Bahamoote SP230GF]] in that it is one of the few Warrior Wheels to be symmetrical from left-to-right. Each side has various spikes and protrusions. It has six holes (three per side) that cause the Element Wheel used to be seen even more, like as if it is a skeleton similar to the Gargoyle Warrior Wheel. The hole housing the Element Wheel is at the top but down ad the bottom, two opposite-facing paws of Fenrir with five claws each are shown.

==Element Wheel - Phantom==
[[File:Necromancer3.png|150px|left]]
Phantom is a semi-clear purple Element Wheel that has curves.

==Spin Track - Tornado 125==

==Shogun Face Bolt - Orojya Revizer==
The stone face shows Revizer and Orojya combined. Orojya depicts the mythical creature "Yamata no Orochi" or just "Orochi" which has 8 heads and 8 tails. Revizer depicts "Leviathan" which is a sea dwelling serpent. The Stone Face shows Leviathan facing to the left with a sinister grin. While with Orojya, it shows 3 heads of Orojya also facing to the left while opening it's mouth, showing it's fangs. It is a turquoise-ish in color.

==Warrior Wheel - Revizer==
'''Weight: '''30.5 grams

Showing off quite the impression of being circular, Revizer carries many elements of its source material into its appearance. The most noticeable would be the Revizer's head that is resting atop of the Warrior Wheel with a menacing expression. The tail of the legendary creature follows this as it whip-lashes and circles the entire Wheel. Some subtle wave-pool and oceanic designs are then carried to other distinguishable areas but does not fail to showcase some holes here-and-there.

Being the almost-circular Warrior Wheel that it is, two holes at two of its sides stop it from achieving the perfection. These holes are formed by the sea-riding waves details that can be visualized additionally as yet another leviathan raising its jaws. It is light blue with green stickers.

==Warrior Wheel - Orojya==
'''Weight: '''29.3 grams

This Warrior Wheel consists of a ring circled by multiple snakes. These engraved serpents create small protrusions all around Orojya, like a gear. Following the characteristic of all Shogun Steel Beyblades, Orojya has a hole for the Element Wheel's orb to protrude into, and two snake heads encase it from each side with their fangs. Some swirly designs exist in the inner part of this Warrior Wheel, all the way down to the opposite side of the crystal, where a menacing face is formed. Made to resemble a snake's head in a front view, two evil eyes are engraved as well as small fangs near the edge of Orojya, and that big head's apparent mustaches are prolonged to become the many small serpents encircling the rest of the Warrior Wheel. This wheel could be useful for defense in the synchrom combo ''MSF-H/MSF Orojya-Killerken GB145/ED145RS/CS. ''Also most parts are covered by serpents and/or sea snakes. It is turquoise in color.

It is the [[Synchrome]] of [[Guardian Leviathan 160SB]] and [[Pirate Orochi 145D]].

==Shogun Face Bolt - Leviathan==
[[File:Reviser.png|150px|left]]
The Face Bolt depicts the profile of the sea-dwelling serpent, the Leviathan. With a bright-green skin, this sea serpent rises from the waves of an ocean whereas its tail swirls into the sea with a webbed tail fin. It soon reaches to the point where it curves up to the right to raise head-high, the Leviathan's head. Slightly raising its beak-like mouth to a grin that is very sinister-esque, other webbed proportions come about just next to it. Complimented with a menacing-like, bright-yellow, pupil-less eye, a small nostril and a vast amount of diamonds that scour its body. The Leviathan is finalized on a lime-green background with a bright-blue outing very fitting to act as the waves of the ocean.

==Warrior Wheel - Leviathan==
[[File:Chromewheel revizer1.jpg|150px|left]]
Showing off quite the impression of being circular, Leviathan carries many elements of its source material into its appearance. The most noticeable would be the Leviathan's head that is resting atop of the Warrior Wheel with a menacing expression. The tail of the legendary creature follows this as it whip-lashes and circles the entire Wheel. Some subtle wave-pool and oceanic designs are then carried to other distinguishable areas but does not fail to showcase some holes here-and-there.

Being the almost-circular Warrior Wheel that it is, two holes at two of its sides stop it from achieving the perfection. These holes are formed by the sea-riding waves details that can be visualized additionally as yet another Leviathan raising its jaws.

==Warrior Wheel - Orochi==
[[File:Chromewheel orojya.jpg|150px|left]]
This Warrior Wheel consists of a ring circled by multiple snakes. These engraved serpents create small protrusions all around Orochi, like a gear. Following the characteristic of all Shogun Steel Beyblades, Orochi has a hole for the Element Wheel's orb to protrude into, and two snake heads encase it from each side with their fangs. Some swirly designs exist in the inner part of this Warrior Wheel, all the way down to the opposite side of the crystal, where a menacing face is formed. Made to resemble a snake's head in a front view, two evil eyes are engraved as well as small fangs near the edge of Orochi, and that big head's apparent mustaches are prolonged to become the many small serpents encircling the rest of the Warrior Wheel. This wheel could be useful for defense in the synchrom combo ''MSF-H/MSF Orochi-Kraken GB145/ED145RS/CS. ''Also most parts are covered by serpents and/or sea snakes.
